info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Nitrate Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Nitrate Produce Catalog Management API allows businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed information regarding nitrate produce products within their catalog. This API enables users to submit all relevant details about nitrate produce items, facilitating enhanced inventory management and product categorization. Ideal for businesses in agricultural retail or food distribution, this API streamlines the process of updating product offerings to meet market demands. Developers can integrate this functionality into their systems to ensure accurate product listings and availability.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information about nitrate production, including specific metrics and characteristics essential for production management.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the details necessary for producing nitrates. It includes all required parameters in a structured format to ensure proper processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested nitrate production details.

CreateCatalogNitrateProduceDetailRequest.title: Nitrate Produce Request Body

nitrate_produce_id.description: Unique identifier for the nitrate produce.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the nitrate produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of nitrate produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of nitrate produce.

CreateCatalogNitrateProduceDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a new nitrate produce entry.

CreateCatalogNitrateProduceDetailRespons.title: Nitrate Produce Details Operations Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating its success or failure.

recordId.description: Unique identifier for the record created or processed during the operation.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the processing of the request was completed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the criteria during the operation.

CreateCatalogNitrateProduceDetailRespons.description: Response schema for successful operations relating to nitrate produce details. Contains information about the operation's status, record identification, processing timestamp, and the count of matched records.
